user_query: I want to create a relaxing playlist for my yoga session. Can you suggest some calming tracks from Soundcloud? Also, fetch the album details of one of the recommended songs using Deezer.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of calming tracks suitable for yoga sessions from Soundcloud.
Select one of the recommended calming tracks to fetch its album details from Deezer.
Retrieve and display the album details of the selected track from Deezer.
